title: How Did Two YouTubers Sell $1.2B of Drinks?
description:
How did Logan Paul and KSI sell $1.2 billion of drinks in one year?

scenes.narration: How did two YouTubers sell over a billion dollars of drinks in one year? Logan Paul and KSI.
January 2022. Two old rivals. Over 40 million YouTube subscribers between them. One Instagram live, and Prime was born.
Here's the flip. They didn't build a factory. A drinks company called Congo runs the business, and Refresco bottles it. Their real job? The audience.
Kids lined up at supermarkets. One eBay listing asked 400 pounds for twelve bottles.
Sales hit 250 million dollars in 2022. Then 1.2 billion in 2023.
But hype fades. By June 2025, UK sales were down 71 percent.
